name: Quaggoth
sourceDistinctions: Underdark directs readers to the 2001 Monsters of Faerûn entry and gives 3 racial Hit Dice, LA +2, favored Barbarian, and ECL 5.
The 2004 Monster Update converts that three-Hit-Die stat block to 3.5, adds 60-ft. darkvision, and updates the skill and feat entries.
The ability modifiers are derived from the original stat block with the core monster-as-character rule.
The 2007 Drow of the Underdark Quaggoth has four racial Hit Dice and different rage, defenses, natural weapons, and senses.
The original three-Hit-Die sources remain the basis of this profile. The collected archive has no Underdark errata file.
portraitForm: Rusk Chalkback, an original Quaggoth beast-follower with undyed fur
